items.t: Said that redistricting in the middle of a decade means not having accurate numbers.
items.q: We're in the middle of a decade. And when you re-district in the middle of a decade, you don't have accurate numbers," said Democratic state Rep. Carolyn Hugley.

record.t: Was elected Minority Leader by members of the Georgia House Democratic Caucus.
record.q: In 2024, Representative Hugley was elected by members of the Georgia House Democratic Caucus to serve as Minority Leader.

record.t: Served as Minority Whip of the Georgia House of Representatives from 2003 to 2018, the first African American to hold that post.
record.q: She was the first African American to serve as Minority Whip of the Georgia House of Representatives (2003-2018).

record.t: Was elected in 1992 to the Georgia House of Representatives.
record.q: Minority Leader Carolyn Fleming Hugley was elected in 1992 to the Georgia House of Representatives.

record.t: Sponsored HB 731 along with other Democratic House members.
record.q: The bill–HB 731–is sponsored by Mary Margaret Oliver (D-83rd), Stacey Abrams (D-89th), Carolyn Hugley (D-136th), Pat Gardiner (D-57th)
